claim: The Berline-Vergne construction takes a rational positive-definite form and returns a local Euler-Maclaurin formula. If some form gives no negative class, the nonnegative-class lemma closes the full-dimensional half of the rank-five rung with no cell and no counting. This step runs the first gate of that programme: the vertex-sum identity, which is necessary for a candidate form and needs no Ehrhart computation.
approved: independent reviews of 2026-09-05 recorded in ../../ADMISSION.md, ACCEPT WITH AMENDMENTS, eleven amendments; this step discharges amendments 3, 4 and 5 and part of 1
gate: for a lattice polytope the local formula read at codimension equal to the dimension says the weights of the tangent cones at the vertices sum to 1
forms: twice the standard form, as the scale-invariance control
the A_6 root-lattice form, chosen because its automorphism group is large so a usable collapse survives
the form with unit diagonal and every off-diagonal entry one quarter
not claimed: the gate is necessary and not sufficient; passing it does not establish that a form gives a valid local formula
